ModMetaData.name: Loadout Quality for Combat Extended
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Quality control for Combat Extended loadouts — no extra interface, just a settings page.
When a pawn is idle, it fetches the best available copy of each weapon its loadout calls for: - Guns: the highest-quality copy on the map, hit points breaking ties. - Melee weapons: the highest melee DPS — which folds in the material, so a plasteel copy rightly beats a higher-quality steel one — hit points breaking ties.
Set the minimum quality worth acquiring and the hit-point tiebreak granularity in the mod settings. The replaced weapon is dropped in place, unforbidden, for your haulers.
Requires Combat Extended. Works fine alongside Simple Sidearms and the CE+SS compatibility suite, but needs neither.
